requirement.statement: 每次发往 provider 的请求 SHALL 在 ProviderCallDomain 落一条 ProviderCallRecord 记录：包含 actorKey、turnId、modelRef、temperature 等模型参数、tool schemas snapshot、prompt generation 引用、startedAt；该记录 SHALL 是该次 provider 请求的事实真相，runtime-control evidence 与 cooperative state.inflight 中相关字段 SHALL 退化为该记录的引用。

case.given: buildProviderPromptForActorTurn 完成 + LLM adapter createStream 即将调用
case.then: ProviderCallDomain SHALL 已写入一条 ProviderCallRecord 含完整请求元数据
state.inflight.kind=&quot;llm&quot; 的 opId SHALL 与该 ProviderCallRecord 一一对应

case.given: 需要查询某次 provider 请求的 temperature 或 tool schemas
case.then: SHALL 通过 ProviderCallDomain ProviderCallRecord 找到
SHALL NOT 仅靠 PromptPlanData 或 effect evidence 拼出来

requirement.statement: assistant message 的 reasoning_content 与 final content SHALL 在 ProviderCallDomain 中作为两个独立事实记录；下游消费者（MessageAssembly、TUI cards、observability）SHALL 通过显式字段读取，不再依赖 on-the-fly merge 进 content_parts 的隐式约定。

case.given: provider 返回的 assistant message 同时含 reasoning_content 与 content
case.then: SHALL 分别记录 reasoning fact 与 content fact，各带 emittedAt
SHALL NOT 仅以合并后的 content_parts 数组形式保存

case.given: TUI think card 或 observability 需要 reasoning
case.then: SHALL 通过 ProviderCallDomain reasoning fact 查询
SHALL NOT 通过 content_parts.find(type===&quot;reasoning&quot;) 隐式约定

requirement.statement: provider 请求失败 SHALL 在 ProviderCallDomain 显式分类为：network_error / provider_rate_limit / provider_invalid_response / aborted_by_user / timeout 等枚举类型；SHALL NOT 仅以&quot;Error: ...&quot;字符串前缀承载错误语义。

case.then: SHALL 写入显式 failureKind 枚举字段
SHALL 同时保留原始 error 字符串作为 audit 字段

requirement.statement: Provider transport retries SHALL replay one already-prepared request only within the existing bounded policy and only while runtime evidence proves no provider output was observed; runtime output evidence SHALL override a classifier's pre-accept hint.

case.given: a recognized transient transport close occurs before output
case.then: the same prepared request authority SHALL be reused and diagnostics SHALL identify a bounded safe pre-accept replay

case.given: a visible chunk or driver output-observed fact exists before failure
case.when: the retry boundary reconciles classifier hints with runtime facts
case.then: runtime evidence SHALL win, effective phase SHALL be provider_accepted, and no new attempt SHALL be created

requirement.statement: Provider cache observation epoch SHALL be projected from the same provider-context receipt authority that admits provider-visible non-append changes; independent continuation counters MUST NOT mask a receipt transition through numeric max/merge.

case.given: history compaction creates a successor provider-context receipt and re-anchors durable context facts
case.when: the first provider request is materialized from the compacted history
case.then: its cache observation SHALL carry the successor receipt epoch on that same request, so comparison with the predecessor is epoch_boundary

case.given: a Responses continuation baseline counter is numerically greater than both predecessor and successor provider-context receipt epochs
case.when: a generic provider cache observation identity is projected
case.then: the receipt transition SHALL remain visible and MUST NOT be collapsed by taking the maximum counter

case.given: provider-visible history only grows by admitted append and the provider-context receipt is unchanged
case.then: they SHALL retain one context epoch and remain eligible for exact forward-prefix comparison
